Class SortGraph

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.SortGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
public class SortGraph extends Object implements edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Task
A task that sorts the various elements of a story graph.
  • The graph's symbols (its StoryGraph.characters, StoryGraph.fluents, StoryGraph.values, and StoryGraph.actions) are sorted alphabetically.
  • The graph's plans are sorted based on the order of the graph's actions, where the last action in the plan is considered first, then the second to last, etc. This increases the chances that a plan can be stored as a TailPlan to save memory.
  • The graph's nodes, states, and edges are sorted ascending based on their distance from the root node according to breadth-first search.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
